claim: Hyperscale data centres now operate just under 1.15 PUE, while legacy enterprise facilities are closer to 2.0. Google's own fleet-wide figure is about 1.09.
comparisonContext: PUE describes how much non-IT overhead sits on top of computing. On older enterprise infrastructure, overhead can be as large as the computing load itself.
scopeNote: IEA provides the enterprise-versus-hyperscale framing; Google's paper provides the company-specific 1.09 figure.
